first_run.title: Welcome to Agent Office
first_run.subtitle: A two-minute setup. You can change everything later in Settings.
first_run.root_hint: Point this at the folder that holds your code. Each direct subfolder becomes a candidate project. Tilde paths (~) and absolute paths both work.

first_run.agents_hint: These are demo agents you can import. They give you a sense of how the app works — feel free to delete the ones you won't use, or untick them now.
first_run.project_hint: Pick one of the folders we scanned and we'll set it up as your first project. You can skip this and create projects later.
first_run.project_empty: No subfolders found under {root}. You can skip this step and create a project later.
first_run.project_skip_hint: Skip by clicking Finish without picking a folder.
first_run.requirements_hint: Agent Office runs agents by shelling out to the Claude CLI. It must be installed and authenticated on this machine.
first_run.req_claude_install: Install instructions: run `npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code` then re-open this app.
first_run.req_claude_auth_note: After installing, run `claude` once in a terminal to log in.
first_run.req_block: Claude CLI must be installed before you can continue.

cleanup_panel.title: Cleanup
cleanup_panel.hero_sub: Surgical resets. Each one names exactly what it clears and what it keeps. Analytics survives everything except the bulk erase.
cleanup_panel.row_transcripts_desc: Empties every chat panel. Run history and analytics are kept.
cleanup_panel.row_drafts_desc: Discards every in-progress prompt sitting in a composer.
cleanup_panel.row_orphaned_runs_desc: Deletes runs left interrupted by an app crash or forced kill.
cleanup_panel.row_agent_memory_desc: Removes per-agent memory. The global memory file is preserved.
cleanup_panel.row_user_analysis_desc: Deletes the About You dossier. Regenerates on the next analyst run.
cleanup_panel.row_skill_cache_desc: Wipes installed skills. They reinstall on next use.
cleanup_panel.row_ui_settings_desc: Clears theme, layout, and tab persistence. Migration sentinel is kept.
cleanup_panel.erase_desc: Every row above plus runs, messages, tool calls, and pipeline history. Analytics is destroyed. Files in your projects are untouched.

performance_tab.title: Rendering budget
performance_tab.hero_sub: How much work the interface is allowed to do per frame. Applies immediately, no reload.
performance_tab.auto_detected_after: because your OS is set to reduced motion. Change it below and this notice disappears.
performance_tab.mode_full_note: Everything on. Best-looking interface, heaviest per frame.
performance_tab.mode_lite_note: Flat surfaces, no PixiJS. Fast on older or throttled machines.
performance_tab.mode_off_note: Minimal render load. Utilitarian, no motion beyond status.
performance_tab.matrix_sub: override any single row without leaving your mode
performance_tab.footer_note: status LEDs keep animating in every mode — they are essential feedback
